refnamediv.refpurpose: Get the current character from an input

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoInputGetCharacter function gets the current character from object by calling the function pointed to by getCharacter in the SilikoInputVTable of object.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoInputGetCharacter relays the return value of the call to function pointed to by getCharacter, either the current character if object has characters to read, or \0 if object is exhausted).
